Problem Statement:
Write a program to sort an array of non-negative floating-point numbers between 0 and 1 using Bucket Sort.
input_spec:
First line: An integer n (number of elements)
Second line: n space-separated floating-point numbers (each in range [0, 1))
output_spec:
Sorted array in ascending order (space-separated, each rounded to 2 decimal places)
